title: A demo of the product on the test bed: faults of several cases planted together, to be ticked and followed from the screens. The planted pull requests touch separate lines of package.json (a bump of express next to one of lodash conflicts by construction, which is case 07's own scenario)

plants.title: build(deps): Bump express from 4.16.0 to 5.1.0 and the base image to node 22
plants.body: A major bump that removes the catch-all route syntax the application uses, with the base image it needs (express 5 requires a recent node): the build fails until the code changes.

plants.title: build(deps): Bump left-pad from 1.0.0 to 1.3.0
plants.body: A grain of sand, on purpose: this pull request carries two tests that contradict each other (the same call must answer 200 and 503), so no change to the source can make it pass, and the tests may not be touched. The flow must put it aside and go on with everything else.

shop-api.summary: Prototype pollution in a function of lodash
